evals.prompt: i recorded our client call, it's at ~/Videos/calls/client-call-oct.mp4. pull out the transcript and tell me every change he asked for
evals.expected_output: A transcript file with timestamps saved next to the recording, screen notes if a document was shared, then a question about what deliverable is wanted, then a grouped bullet list of the requested changes with timestamps.

evals.prompt: there's a 40 minute standup recording in this folder (meet-2026-10-13.webm). I need action items with owners for the team, as a pdf I can drop in slack
evals.expected_output: Extraction and transcription run locally; after asking what is needed (or taking the stated need), a one or two page PDF with an action-item table (owner, action, by when, source timestamp) in the house style, checked page by page.

evals.prompt: my boss sent a voice note (m4a) walking through what the new dashboard should do. can you write it up properly
evals.expected_output: Audio-only path: no contact sheets, transcript with a vocabulary prompt, then a short written requirements note grouped by area with timestamps, offered in markdown and optionally as a PDF.
